hero.title: Nordic Guarantee
hero.subtitle: Nordic Guarantee, an international company specialized in financial guarantees and surety insurance with presence across Europe, invited us to document a corporate event held at the Hotel Miramar in Málaga.

sections.title: El desafío
sections.description: Nordic Guarantee, an international company specialized in financial guarantees and surety insurance with presence across Europe, invited us to document a corporate event held at the Hotel Miramar in Málaga, with representatives from the United States, South Africa and several European countries. The goal was to produce a photographic report reflecting the international nature of the gathering and the importance of in-person networking, as well as institutional material for internal communications, corporate website and social media.

sections.title: La estrategia
sections.description: We approached the project from a corporate and institutional photography perspective, combining event coverage with image production aimed at reinforcing and documenting the brand identity and the importance of the event. The focus centered on capturing both key moments of the gathering and attendee interaction, prioritizing a visual narrative that conveyed professionalism, warmth, and the company's European character. We also produced a set of institutional photographs of the team and corporate environment for use across various communication channels.

sections.title: El resultado
sections.description: We delivered a high-quality image bank that documented the event and strengthened Nordic Guarantee's visual communication internationally. The material was used on their corporate website and social media, bringing visual consistency to their digital presence and reinforcing their positioning as a European company specialized in financial solutions and guarantees.
